body.title: Adaptive recommendation engine for products. Machine learning, cold start, API design.
body.aiReason: ML engineering, Python, AWS, data pipelines, recommendation system match core skills and positioning; detailed, legitimate brief with no red flags.
body.description:
Product development team is looking for a firm for a fixed-fee, 3–6 month engagement to turn our working recommendation prototype, which currently runs on a single PC, into a hosted production service.
The firm will build an adaptive recommendation engine that personalizes what each user should see based on how their own content performs, with a feedback loop that keeps adjusting to their emerging performance instead of locking the creator into one niche.
The engine will be exposed through an API that our web portal and iOS app consume, plus potentially an agent interface (such as an MCP server).
While LLMs could become a part of this eventually, the scope of this project is a recommender, which should not depend on LLM access.
The engagement ends with documentation and training so our team owns the system afterward. There is potential for ongoing work as our team are not experts in machine learning systems.
Hosting Python services and scheduled jobs on AWS (ECS or Lambda) with infrastructure-as-code (OpenTofu/Terraform)
Data engineering against our warehouse (Redshift / Aurora), including pipelines for performance data
Recommender and ranking systems with feedback loops (personalization, cold start, evaluation)
API design for React and iOS consumers, including auth (JWT/Cognito)
